n1.speaker: thora
n1.text: I led a clan, once. A healer, a mother to all of them.

n2.speaker: thora
n2.text: I couldn't save them all when we crossed. I still don't know why I lived and they didn't.

choices.text: "That wasn't a failure. You did everything you could."
"You don't owe anyone an explanation for surviving."
